question.problem:
Consider the equation $\operatorname{sin}⁡(4x-\frac{\pi }{4})=-\frac{1}{2}$ for $0\le x<\pi .$ If the solutions ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3},{x}_{4}$ are written in **ascending order**, what are their values? Express your answers in terms of $\pi .$

${x}_{1}=${{field-1}}$,\,$
${x}_{2}=${{field-2}}$,\,$
${x}_{3}=${{field-3}}$,\,$
${x}_{4}=${{field-4}}
question.worked_solution:
We will find the general solution to the equation, and then generate all of the solutions in the required domain.

The general solution to our equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}4x-\frac{\pi }{4} & =\frac{7\pi }{6}+2n\pi , & \, & \, & 4x-\frac{\pi }{4} & =\frac{11\pi }{6}+2n\pi .\end{aligned}
$$

Solving the two equations above for $x$ gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}4x & =\frac{7\pi }{6}+\frac{\pi }{4}+2n\pi  & \, & \, & 4x & =\frac{11\pi }{6}+\frac{\pi }{4}+2n\pi  \\ 4x & =\frac{17\pi }{12}+2n\pi  & \, & \, & 4x & =\frac{25\pi }{12}+2n\pi  \\ x & =\frac{17\pi }{48}+\frac{n\pi }{2} & \, & \, & x & =\frac{25\pi }{48}+\frac{n\pi }{2} \\ x & =\frac{17\pi }{48}+\frac{24n\pi }{48} & \, & \, & x & =\frac{25\pi }{48}+\frac{24n\pi }{48} \\ x & =\frac{(24n+17)\pi }{48} & \, & \, & x & =\frac{(24n+25)\pi }{48}\end{aligned}
$$

We set $n=0,\pm 1,\pm 2,…,$ until we have generated all solutions in the domain $0\le x<\pi .$

- Setting $n=0$ gives $x=\frac{17\pi }{48}$ and $x=\frac{25\pi }{48}$

- Setting $n=-1$ gives $x=-\frac{7\pi }{48}$ (too small) and $x=\frac{\pi }{48}$

- Setting $n=1$ gives $x=\frac{41\pi }{48}$ and $x=\frac{49\pi }{48}$ (too big)

All other values of $n$ generate solutions outside the domain $0\le x<\pi .$ So, the solutions ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3},{x}_{4}$ (written in ascending order) are

$$
x=\frac{\pi }{48},\frac{17\pi }{48},\frac{25\pi }{48},\frac{41\pi }{48}.
$$

Therefore, we conclude that:

$$
{x}_{1}=\frac{\pi }{48},\,{x}_{2}=\frac{17\pi }{48},\,{x}_{3}=\frac{25\pi }{48},\,{x}_{4}=\frac{41\pi }{48}
$$
